title.narrative: Scaling Up Innovative Approaches to Respond to TB Challenges in Afghanistan - Afghanistan (01-Apr-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Afghanistan, Tuberculosis, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Afghanistan)This program has the following goals: To reduce TB mortality by 50% at the end of 2018 compared to 2013. The objectives of this program are: To detect and treat at least 50% of estimated MDR-TB cases by 2018. To increase the case notification of all TB cases at least 6 % by year and to maintain treatment success rate, at least, 90% by 2018
